title: LookShots
description: Data files content/look/shots*.json: shot sets of the screenshot tool (B2 R32). It renders every fixed camera point in every projection and day phase as PNG, and optionally in every listed epoch, season and weather. shots.json is the default set (the T1 pictures); further sets such as shots_dimensions.json are chosen with --shot-set. Presentation only.

settle_frames.description: Frames to render before each picture (shaders, shadows).

epochs.description: Optional: epochs from content/look/epochs.json; each picture then shows the palette of the epoch. Missing = the base palette, as before.

seasons.description: Optional: seasons from content/world/time.json; each picture then shows the season palette of content/look/palette.json. Missing = the base palette, as before.

weather.description: Optional: weather ids from content/vocabulary/weather.json. Weather without a look yet is rendered unchanged with a note in the file name.

inhabitant.description: Optional: look at the inhabitant with this index (ordered by id) instead of the map target.

pitch_deg.description: Optional: camera pitch of this shot in degrees (may leave the player's range, e.g. to show the sky); default camera.json pitch_deg.

fov_deg.description: Optional: field of view of this shot in degrees (perspective); default camera.json fov_deg.

phase.description: Optional: this point is shot only in this day phase of the set's phases (e.g. the night set: overview at night, close view at dusk).

scene.description: Optional: the scene finder picks the target near a start instead of the map target (the permille target is the fallback when no spot fits).

ShotScene.description: What the scene finder looks for per seed (TL #19722 comparison shots): a spot near a start whose view radius holds running water, a spring and a hill.

max_start_distance_cells.description: Largest distance of the target from a start position in cells.

radius_cells.description: Radius around the target that must hold the scene.

min_stream_cells.description: Fewest running stream cells within the radius.

spring.description: Whether a spring must lie within the radius.

min_relief.description: Smallest height difference (height units) within the radius: a hill.

face_hill.description: Turn the camera so the highest ground within the radius lies behind the target (the shot point's yaw otherwise).
